title: Gate-list parsing
statement: For a fixed number $n$ of input variables and a natural-number parsing bound $m$, the gate-list parser returns either failure or a list of gates. It accepts the single-bit list $[\mathrm{false}]$ as the empty list; within the bound, a leading $\mathrm{true}$ signals a gate to parse, followed recursively by the remaining gates, while any other input pattern fails.
